name: Nakatonbetsu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nakatonbetsu town emblem in white: an outlined cog-like ring enclosing a ring with a vertical bar.
history: Municipal flag of Nakatonbetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 7 November 1933.

features.role: Nakatonbetsu town emblem — an outlined cog-like ring enclosing a ring with a vertical bar
